def mod_pow(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    mod = 1000000007
    res = 1
    a %= mod
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            res = (res * a) % mod
        a = (a * a) % mod
        b >>= 1
    return res

def order(k: int, p: int) -> int:
    x = k
    ord_val = 1
    while x != 1:
        x = (x * k) % p
        ord_val += 1
    return ord_val

def main() -> None:
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    if k == 0:
        power = p - 1
    elif k == 1:
        power = p
    else:
        ord_val = order(k, p)
        power = (p - 1) // ord_val
    print(mod_pow(p, power))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
